text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho~! Extra dash, finished!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san! Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kita-san. Are you still here as well?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A few more dashes! I'm thinking of 
heading outside after this, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... You certainly are working 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to be like Teio-san! Right now, all 
I can do is give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...What beautiful legs. They look like 
they could run extraordinarily well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...! Um, err...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That seems to be precisely why it is 
difficult to notice. That you are 
overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the icing is complete. Please be sure 
to give it a thorough massage as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. But, why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to catch up to Teio-san... I 
understand that feeling all too well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, if you focus solely on her 
because of that and fail to notice the 
changes within yourself... that wouldn't 
do, would it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us both be careful. Now then, if you 
will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san was wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san's rivals really are incredible! 
All right, I gotta...!
